item.title: How new federal funding could impact Montana's most rural medical facilities
item.description: Frances Mahon Deaconess Hospital serves an area of northeastern Montana with about 25,000 people in 14,000 square miles. Leaders say providing health care over an area like that comes with challenges.

item.title: Montana State undeterred by bright lights of Nashville, focused on 'the main thing' ahead of FCS championship
item.description: The Montana State football team now knows the championship routine, but the Bobcats are focused on "making the main thing the main thing."

item.title: Among continued growth, Bobcat Collective partners with Barstool Nashville for home-base celebration
item.description: The Bobcat Collective partnered with Barstool Nashville to create a home base for MSU fans over the weekend in Nashville. It's another step in the continued growth of the collective connecting.
